newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 30,000/T May 6-10 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 30,000/T May 6-10 fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp has issued a tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke fuel oil for delivery May 6-10, industry sources said on Thursday.
The cargo is to be delivered to Bombay on the west coast, they said.
The tender closes April 24 and is valid until April 25.
Sources said India had cancelled an earlier tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of fuel oil for delivery between May 5-8 which was due to close April 23 with offers valid until April 24.
